name: Exception (istithnāʾ)
definition: Taking a word out of what was said of the rest, with illā or its sisters; the word taken out is the mustathnā.
body: After illā in a complete, affirmative sentence the mustathnā is in naṣb: qāma al-qawmu illā zaydan. In a complete, negative sentence it may follow as a badal or be in naṣb: mā qāma aḥadun illā zaydun / zaydan. In an incomplete sentence it takes whatever case the governor gives: mā qāma illā zaydun.
After ghayr, siwā, suwā and sawāʾ it is in jarr; after khalā, ʿadā and ḥāshā either naṣb or jarr.
